site.description: QGIS course instructor Seunghyeon Lee (UPWISE). QGIS·Python·remote sensing online courses on Inflearn. 1,000+ students, 4.9 rating. Available for public-sector, university, and corporate training.
site.keywords: QGIS, QGIS instructor, GIS instructor, GIS training, Python GIS, remote sensing, UPWISE, Seunghyeon Lee, spatial data analysis, QGIS automation

hero.eyebrow: Hello, I'm Seunghyeon Lee (UPWISE), a GIS instructor.
hero.description:
I teach spatial data analysis and visualization using QGIS, Python, and PostGIS.
With clear explanations and hands-on examples that beginners can follow to the end, I build courses you can apply right away.

about.title: About
paragraphs: Through GIS, I give data its spatial context and deliver that meaning in a form that can be put to use in the field.
I majored in GIS and remote sensing at the Graduate School of Environmental Studies, Seoul National University, combining research and teaching with spatial data.

Structured in the order Beginner → Visualization → Automation to learn QGIS step by step.

items.title: QGIS Beginner All-in-One Starter Pack (Theory/Practice)
items.description:
A comprehensive intro course covering everything from GIS fundamentals to real-world analysis.
Theory and practice combined so beginners can follow through to the end.

items.title: QGIS Map Visualization A to Z (Vector/Basics)
items.shortTitle: QGIS Map Visualization A to Z
items.description:
Create 7 thematic maps yourself through QGIS visualization and layout practice.
Gain the skills to make presentation- and report-ready maps from public data.

items.title: A Taste of Trendy QGIS Visualization (Election Map)
items.description:
A free course visualizing the 20th presidential election results by district.
Recommended for anyone who wants to try QGIS the fastest way.

items.title: QGIS Python Automation (Vector) Ver.2
items.description:
A practical course automating repetitive GIS tasks with pyQGIS code.
From Python basics to automation — two birds with one stone.
